QUOTE: approved = auto_approve_tools OR allow-list match on "tool:first-arg" ... Step 3 is `ToolExecutor::check_approval` (`src/mcp/tool_executor.cpp`, lines 161–188). It asks `ServerManager::is_explicitly_allowed`
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer places the allow list in check_approval (the approval step), but it never states that the allow list doesn't grant execution or merely suppresses approval. It also says allow-listed calls can still be denied in step 4, which doesn't amount to saying the allow list is only an approval-suppressor consulted from that one place.
